records.title: [Analysis of clinical symptoms of cases of human decompression disease in altitude chamber studies].
records.evidence_note: The original English abstract gives 130 volunteers and more than 2,400 ascents. The official JPRS translation gives exact clinical and exposure totals.

records.title: [Comparative study of decompression-induced formation of gas bubbles using ultrasonic equipment and the development of altitude-decompression disorders].
records.evidence_note: The abstract reports 442 experiments and 40 volunteers. It reports numbers of people with determined thresholds, which do not establish the number of clinical DCS cases out of 442 experiments. Participant or experiment overlap with the Iseev 1975–1986 series is unresolved.

records.title: [Relation between the probability of development of altitude-decompression disorders and the duration of pre-exposure to a hypobaric atmosphere].
records.evidence_note: Experimental volunteers and a pre-exposure comparison. Record retained as a related report. No match to personnel-level data from the 1975–1986 series has been established.

records.title: [Hypobaric atmosphere and decompression safety of outer space explorations on the first days of flight].
records.evidence_note: The abstract describes 54 volunteers and 298 tests in eight experimental series investigating pressure transitions for extravehicular activity. These counts describe research participation.

records.title: [The assessment of the risk of altitude decompression sickness during simulation of repeated (with 12 hour interval) exits into open space].
records.evidence_note: The author abstract reports 24 ascents by six male volunteers, with zero ascents producing clinical signs of altitude decompression sickness. Doppler bubbles are a separate endpoint. The PDF was unavailable in Undermind.

observations.note: Six repeated-exposure volunteers. No operational chamber staff and trainee cohorts were reported.

records.title: [Prevention of altitude decompression sickness during simulation of egress from the cabin of space vehicle with hypobaric artificial atmosphere].
records.evidence_note: This is the separate study by Chadov and colleagues, with 22 volunteers and 115 experiments. The existing v1.6 source contains the trial counts. The distinct issue, title and pagination separate it from the Katuntsev 2001 article, although volunteer overlap remains unknown.

records.title: Analysis of clinical symptoms of human decompression sickness during altitude chamber studies
records.evidence_note: Methods report 2,444 altitude tests on 130 volunteers from January 1975 to August 1986. Results report 250 symptomatic cases (10.2%). The p. 19 subtype summary gives 219 musculo-articular cases and notes three mixed cases in the cutaneous category. The p. 21 narrative refers to 221 musculo-articular cases. Preserve this discrepancy without deriving subtype-specific incidence or assuming that the categories are independent.

observations.locator: JPRS translation, Methods and Results and Discussion, pp. 18–19 (scan pp. 22–23)
observations.note: The tests used varied experimental conditions and included repeat participation. A pooled operational training role comparison requires paired exposure counts for staff and trainees, which this series does not report.
